messages:
maya (CS): FYI: Zenfolio reporting regen on session 'sess_8k4j' is duplicating earlier assistant turns and token counts spike. They say billing jumped 3x.
maya (CS): Repro steps below from customer (VERBATIM). please triage — they attached logs and a sample payload.
---
Customer repro (copied):
1) Start session and send messages A -> B -> C
2) Call regenerate for last user message (C) using POST /v1/chat/regenerate with session_id=sess_8k4j and message_id=msg_0003
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/regenerate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"session_id":"sess_8k4j","message_id":"msg_0003","model":"redwood-3b"}'

Observed response body (excerpt):
{
  "session_id":"sess_8k4j",
  "messages":[
    {"id":"msg_0001","role":"user","text":"A"},
    {"id":"msg_0002","role":"assistant","text":"B"},
    {"id":"msg_0002_dup","role":"assistant","text":"B"},    <-- DUPLICATE
    {"id":"msg_0003","role":"user","text":"C"},
    {"id":"msg_0004","role":"assistant","text":"NEW RESPONSE"}
  ],
  "token_usage":{"prompt_tokens":2400,"completion_tokens":800}
}

Expected: only one instance of msg_0002 should appear. Billing spike caused by duplicate assistant tokens.
---
maya (CS): Customer verified workaround: opening new session_id prevents duplication but they lose prior context.
sam (PM): Can we confirm whether this is a storage duplication or a runtime replay bug? tagging @jon @li
jon (ENG): thanks — first pass: looks like regen path may be re-appending cached KV entries when reconstructing prefix. Can you paste exact model name and whether they used streaming? also need full request headers (trace id if present).
maya (CS): They used model redwood-3b, non-streaming. Trace header: X-Request-ID: rq_7f2c9b. Attached customer log snippet:
[2026-02-14T16:42:12Z] rq_7f2c9b reconstruct_prefix session=sess_8k4j kv_entries=12
[2026-02-14T16:42:12Z] rq_7f2c9b apply_kv_cache start
[2026-02-14T16:42:12Z] rq_7f2c9b apply_kv_cache success applied=12
[2026-02-14T16:42:12Z] rq_7f2c9b append_history start
[2026-02-14T16:42:12Z] rq_7f2c9b append_history appended=4
[2026-02-14T16:42:12Z] rq_7f2c9b send_response tokens=3200
maya (CS): Note append_history appended=4 while expected 3. that lines up.
li (SRE): This could be a double-append when regen merges persisted history + in-memory staging buffer. Could reproduce locally with a short script. Jon, can you add a small repro harness that toggles both paths?
jon (ENG): I'll build a unit repro this afternoon. quick hypothesis: regenerate flow calls History.append() once during prefix rebuild and again when finalizing response if a dedupe flag isn't set.
sam (PM): Severity? customer is on Dedicated and seeing cost impact. Recommend P1 for billing impact but P2 for correctness if workaround exists. thoughts?
jon (ENG): I'll treat as P1 for now until we have a mitigation. initial mitigation: server-side dedupe on append_history: if last message id == incoming.id skip. low-risk patch.
ops-bot: Created issue RW-ISSUE-4286: "session regen duplicate assistant turns -> billing spike" assigned to jon (ENG). link: https://redwood.ai/ops/issues/4286
jon (ENG): assigning to myself. plan: repro, write failing unit test, add dedupe guard, run canary on staging. ETA for PR by EOD tomorrow.
maya (CS): told customer we have a ticket and suggested new session as temporary workaround. they responded :relieved:
sam (PM): add to next sprint planning and flag for postmortem if we hit production incidents. also check analytics to find other accounts with >2x regen tokens.
li (SRE): I'll add a query to look for sessions where append_history appended_count > expected_count in logs over the past 30 days.
jon (ENG): acked, will post PR link and test results here. thanks.
maya (CS): thanks team — will keep customer updated.
